content: ˚जन्मन् {%m.%} a Brāhmaṇa (द्विजन्मन्). {@पुनरुक्तवदाभासः@} seeming tautology, appearance of repetition, regarded as a figure of speech; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} भुजंगकुण्डलीव्यक्तशशिशुभ्रांशुशीतगुः . जगन्त्यपि सदापायादव्याच्चेतोहरः शिवः <ls>S. D. 632</ls>; (here the first impression of the tautology is removed when the passage is rightly understood; <ab>cf.</ab> also <ls>K. P. 9</ls> under पुनरुक्तवदाभास).
